title: [spec-gap][R-LOADNG-018/019] Rust LOADng: no RREQ/RREP receive path; HybridRouter discovery methods have no runtime callers
description:
Classification: not-implemented (rust receive side + runtime wiring).

Evidence: rust/lichen-core/src/loadng.rs implements codecs + RouteDiscovery origination typestate (unit-tested, vectors consumed by rust/lichen-core/tests/loadng_vectors.rs) but there is no process_rreq/process_rrep equivalent anywhere in rust/ — no duplicate suppression (B2.6), reverse-route recording, intermediate RREP, or RREP forwarding. rust/lichen-node/src/hybrid.rs start_discovery/on_discovery_timeout/on_rrep_received (hybrid.rs:395-471) are called only from hybrid.rs tests; HybridRouter is referenced nowhere else (rg HybridRouter rust/ -> lib.rs re-export + hybrid.rs). No RREQ_WAIT_TIME/RETRIES constants exist in rust. B2.6 suppression exists in python (discovery.py:369-407) and C (loadng.c:402-536) only.

Suggested placement: rust/lichen-node — wire HybridRouter into the node/stack runtime and add RREQ/RREP receive processing (a lichen-core handler module mirroring python LoadngRouter: seen-window suppression, reverse routes, proxy-flag RREP downgrade already specced in loadng.rs module docs).
